answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after 30 epochs of work graded by panels drawn from unlinked identities, while rewards come from a fixed per-epoch pool. A farm of 1,000 sybils must freeze 1,000 bonds yet still splits the same nectar, so every clone earns less than its capital cost. It works like a saffron wharf: each crate is weighed at the dock before sale, and a short-weight crate forfeits its deposit.
